_note: SCENE BIBLE chế độ cine (docs/VIDEO-PIPELINE.md §13). Mỗi bối cảnh: ảnh phòng tham chiếu, phong cách, vai → vị trí trong khung 2 người (roles), quầy (counter.atAdult = mặt quầy cao bằng bao nhiêu phần chiều cao người lớn – 0,52 ≈ hông), tiếng nền, các blocking preset (prompt khung đầu + prompt chuyển động). {customer}/{barista} = mô tả nhân vật từ cast.json, {ratio} = % chiều cao teen/người lớn, <<<image_N>>> do planner gắn theo thứ tự ảnh tham chiếu. faceZone = vùng mặt dự kiến (tỉ lệ khung) khi bộ dò không bắt được mặt hoạt hình (cổng bố cục ghi measured:false).

cafe.look: cozy cafe interior: warm wooden counter, espresso machine, chalkboard menus, pendant lamps, warm afternoon window light
cafe.style: flat 2D cartoon illustration, clean dark outlines, soft cel shading, exactly the same art style as the character references
cafe.negative: no text overlays, no captions, no logos, no extra people, no readable gibberish writing on signs

two-shot-counter.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide two-shot inside the cafe of <<<room>>>. {customer} (<<<customer>>>) stands on the LEFT in front of the wooden counter, full body visible with both feet on the floor, looking up at {barista} (<<<barista>>>), who stands BEHIND the counter on the RIGHT. Correct real-world scale: the counter top reaches {barista}'s hip; {customerName} is about {ratio}% of {barista}'s height. Both wear exactly the outfits of their references. {style}. Leave the top 15% and bottom 25% of the frame calm (space for captions).
two-shot-counter.motion: {speakerName} talks naturally with small hand gestures while {listenerName} listens and reacts; subtle idle breathing; very slow gentle push-in. Keep both characters' outfits and proportions. No new people, no text appearing.

mcu-customer.subject: customer
mcu-customer.prompt: Vertical 9:16 medium close-up of {customer} (<<<customer>>>) standing at the cafe counter, three-quarter view facing right toward the barista off-screen, same cafe, lighting and art style as <<<frame>>>. Head and shoulders to waist, face in the upper half, mouth clearly visible. {style}.
mcu-customer.motion: {speakerName} speaks to someone off-screen right with natural expression ({emotion}), small head movements and one hand gesture; static camera with a very slight drift. No new people, no text.

ms-barista.subject: barista
ms-barista.prompt: Vertical 9:16 medium shot of {barista} (<<<barista>>>) behind the wooden cafe counter next to the espresso machine, facing left toward the customer off-screen, same cafe, lighting and art style as <<<frame>>>. Waist up, face in the upper half, mouth clearly visible. {style}.
ms-barista.motion: {speakerName} explains kindly to someone off-screen left with an open-hand gesture ({emotion}); static camera with a very slight drift. No new people, no text.
